sloka: ततो विदुद्रुवुः सर्वे तस्मात्रस्ता रणाजिरे ।सुराश्च क्षुभिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा दण्डोद्यतं यमम् ।। ७.२२.३७ ॥
transliteration: tato vidudruvuḥ sarve tasmātrastā raṇājire ।surāśca kṣubhitāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā daṇḍodyataṁ yamam ।। 7.22.37 ॥

translations.english: That great weapon, surrounded by flames as if burning the demon, trembled when touched by the powerful Yama.
